name: Prologue to Battle! The Return of Son Goku
summary: Goku is a legendary warrior and the strongest fighter on the plant, but he's about to encounter a foe from out-of-this-world. What brings this new menace to Earth? And what's up with his tail?

name: The Enemy is Goku's Brother?! The Secret of the Mighty Saiyan Warriors
summary: When Raditz abducts Gohan and announces his plans to conquer Earth, Goku and Piccolo are forced into an uneasy alliance. The two rivals don't trust each other, but neither of them can defeat the Saiyan on their own!

name: A Life-or-Death Battle! Goku and Piccolo's Ferocious Suicide Attack
summary: Despite the fury of their attacks, Goku and Piccolo are unable to land a death blow in their battle against Raditz. Gohan's unexpected outburst manages to weaken the powerful Saiyan, but it may be too little, too late.

name: Run in the Afterlife, Son Goku! The One Million Snake Way!
summary: Now that he's dead, Goku must fight to survive in the afterlife, especially during his treacherous trek down Snake Way. Back on Earth, Gohan endures his own punishment as a student in the house of Piccolo!

name: Wilderness Survival! A Moonlit Night Awakens Gohan
summary: Piccolo tries to toughen up Gohan with some wilderness survival training, but things get hairy when the young Saiyan sees his first full moon! Meanwhile, Yajirobe summons Earth's strongest fighters to Kami's Lookout.

name: The End of the Line is Reached! Playful Trials of Kaiosama
summary: As the deadly Saiyan invaders approach Earth, Gohan makes slow, but steady, progress under the watchful eye of Piccolo, and Goku struggles with the "gravity" of his training under King Kai.

name: The Battle With 10-Times Gravity! Goku, Your Training is a Race
summary: To prove himself worthy of King Kai's training, Goku must test his mettle against a fleet-footed monkey and a powerful cricket that's big on respect. Meanwhile, in the land of the living, Gohan takes a beating from his monstrous master!

name: Come Forth, Shenlong! The Saiyans Finally Arrive on Earth
summary: Goku's training under King Kai is finally complete, and he's eager to return to Earth. Master Roshi uses the Dragon Balls to summon Shenron, but will Goku make it back in time to stop the Saiyans?

name: Yamucha's Struggle! The Terrible Saibaimen
summary: The Saiyans have arrived, Goku isn't even on the planet, and the overmatched Z-Fighters represent Earth's last line of defense. When Vegeta and Nappa unleash the gruesome Saibamen, Yamcha picks a fight that could be his last!

name: Sit Tight, Chaozu! The Screaming Kikoho of Tenshinhan
summary: Krillin's furious attack wipes out the Saibamen, but the Z-Fighters are powerless against the Saiyan warlords. One by one, Earth's defenders suffer devastating injuries - or fall in battle. Goku's return is their only hope for survival.

name: Will Son Goku Be in Time?! 3 Hours Until the Battle Resumes
summary: Piccolo hatches a desperate plan to prolong the battle until Goku's arrival. When Vegeta senses an awesome source of power approaching, he orders Nappa to dispose of remaining Z-Fighters - starting with Gohan!

name: Tears Shed by Piccolo... Son Goku's Furious Counterattack!
summary: Goku arrives in time to save Gohan and Krillin, and the resurrected warrior is eager to put the hurt on Nappa. When it becomes clear that Goku is no ordinary fighter, Prince Vegeta steps into to finish the fight himself!

name: This is the Kaioken! The Critical Battle of Goku vs. Vegeta
summary: The stage is set for a final showdown between Vegeta and Goku. The Saiyan Prince is stronger, faster, and far more ruthless. Goku's only hope for victory is a technique that may very well destroy him!

name: The Impact of the Kamehameha! Vegeta's Tenacious Transformation
summary: Vegeta can't handle the fury of Goku's triple Kaio-Ken technique, so the Saiyan warlord unleashes his inner ape. Weakened by his furious onslaught, Goku's only hope to defeat the beast is the mighty Spirit Bomb!

name: Goku in Absolute Peril! Entrust Your Wishes to the Genki Dama
summary: As Goku lies exhausted and vulnerable on the field of battle, Gohan and Krillin take aim at Vegeta's only weakness: his tail! If they can take the ape out of the fight, they might have a chance to escape with their lives.

name: The Invincible Vegeta Defeated! Son Gohan Summons a Miracle
summary: Krillin and Gohan team up to blast Vegeta with a Spirit Bomb, but the Saiyan prince refuses to die. Things look bad for the Z-Fighters until Yajirobe distracts the enemy long enough for Gohan to undergo a transformation of his own!

name: Dawn of the Fierce Battle... The Star of Hope Is Piccolo's Homeland
summary: Vegeta has been defeated, but there's no time to celebrate. The Z-Fighters must find a way to resurrect the friends who died stopping the Saiyan invasion. Fortunately for the fallen, Krillin has a plan!

name: The Spaceship that Sleeps in Yunzabit! Blast Off for Planet Namek
summary: Preparations for the journey to Namek hit a snag when Bulma accidentally blows up the remaining Saiyan spaceship. Mr. Popo may know of another vessel, so he and Bulma travel to the Earth's end for a closer look.

name: A Formidable New Enemy! Emperor of the Universe, Freeza
summary: A bad case of space boredom makes Bulma a pain to share close quarters with, and Vegeta recovers from his injuries only to discover that Frieza has a head start on tracking down the magic Dragon Balls!

name: Rebellion Against Freeza! Vegeta, Burning with Ambition
summary: Gohan and Krillin beat up on Frieza's henchmen, but their spaceship is destroyed in the process. Vegeta is headed for a showdown with Cui, and the shrewd Saiyan is keeping his true power level under wraps!

name: Protect the Dragon Balls! The Namekian Offensive
summary: Goku blasts off in a brand new spaceship specially equipped with a device designed to help increase his strength! On Namek, Krillin and Gohan watch in horror as Frieza's men slaughter innocent Namekians.

name: Dodoria in Terrifying Hot Pursuit! Vegeta Learns the Truth
summary: Gohan and Krillin risk their lives to rescue a young Namekian, and Vegeta goes on the rampage after learning the truth about the destruction of his home planet!

name: Vegeta's Secret Plan! Tragic Attack Upon the Namekians
summary: After easily defeating Dodoria, Vegeta begins his violent search for the two remaining Dragon Balls. Meanwhile, Krillin and his new friend Dende set out to warn the eldest Namekian of the horror headed his way!

name: Resurrected Companions! The Beauty Soldier Zarbon's Demon Transformation
summary: King Kai telepathically "phones" Goku with a warning to stay as far away from Frieza as possible! Back on Namek, Vegeta is shocked to discover how much a simple transformation can increase Zarbon's power.

name: Kuririn's Power-Up! The Foreboding Squirming of Freeza
summary: The eldest Namekian unlocks the full force of Krillin's dormant power, so the bald brawler can better protect his Dragon Ball. Elsewhere, a Saiyan-related premonition prompts Frieze to call for reinforcements.

name: The Conspiracy Completely Shatters! Vegeta's Counterattack vs. Zarbon
summary: Vegeta lays it on the line in a daring attempt to steal the Dragon Balls right out from under Frieza's nose. Krillin's riding high on a Namekian power surge, but he's about to wander into a dogfight he can't survive!

name: A Hair-Trigger Pinch! Gohan, Protect the Four Star Ball
summary: Intimidated by Vegeta's superior strength, Krillin reluctantly surrenders his precious Dragon Ball. A glimmer of hope remains after Gohan secures a ball of his own - but the young warrior is headed for a beat-down courtesy of Vegeta!

name: The Super Decisive Battle Draws Near! The Ginyu Special Force Has Arrived!
summary: Vegeta intercepts Krillin and Gohan on their mad dash to get powered up by the Eldest Namekian, but larger problems loom on the horizon. Brace yourselves for the arrival of the Ginyu Force!

name: The Special-Squad's Frontline Man! Break Gurudo's Spell
summary: Gohan and Krillin fight to survive against Guldo, a member of the Ginyu Force who possesses awesome psychic abilities! With Goku still in space and Vegeta their only ally, things look bleak for Earth's heroes.

name: The Hellish Recoome! Keep Me Entertained, Vegeta-chan
summary: Vegeta ramps his battle power up to impressive levels, but he's still no match for the Ginyu goons. To escape death, he'll need help from some heroic former enemies. Meanwhile, Frieza tries to unlock the magic of the Dragon Balls.

name: Son Goku Finally Arrives! Knock the Ginyu Special-Squad Around
summary: At long last, Goku finally completes his journey from Earth and arrives on planet Namek. His friends are gravely injured, but the mighty Saiyan warrior has a bag full of magic beans and a powerful secret!

name: Star Performer's Entry!? Captain Ginyu vs. Son Goku
summary: As Frieza prepares for his ruthless interrogation of the Eldest Namekian, Goku shows off the benefits of training in gravity one hundred times that of Earth. Will it be enough to help him defeat Captain Ginyu?

name: Son Goku at Full Power! Ginyu's Secret Trick Trembles!?
summary: Frieza locates the Eldest Namekian, but Nail intercepts the evil entity, risking his own life to preserve the Dragon Balls. Elsewhere, Gohan and Krillin rescue a damsel from some dinosaurs, and Goku continues his battle with Cpt. Ginyu.

name: Surprise! Son Goku is Ginyu and Ginyu is Son Goku!?
summary: Gohan and Krillin unearth the Dragon Balls, but their attempts to summon Shenron fail miserably. Later, Cpt. Ginyu's devious strategy forces Earth's warriors to do the unthinkable: attack Goku's flesh and bones with chilling ferocity!

name: A Great Turnabout For Goku?! Super Shenron, Come Out Right Now!
summary: Goku and his body are reunited, but the noble Saiyan is severely injured and unable to fight. A Namekian messenger rushes to assist Gohan and Krillin in summoning Shenron, but there's no guarantee he'll arrive before Frieza.

name: An Excited Freeza Approaches! Porunga... Before Granting the Wish!
summary: Gohan and Krillin - with the aid of the young Namekian Dende - rush to make their wishes before Vegeta or Frieza discover their trickery. When the dragon is unable to grant their request, a departed ally offers advice from the afterlife.

name: A Tormenting Super Transformation! Freeza's One Million Fighting Power
summary: Piccolo is resurrected and ready to rumble, but his arrival is delayed by an encounter with a dying Namekian. Meanwhile, Vegeta prepares to throw down with Frieza, but the Saiyan prince may be badly overmatched.

name: Freeza Bares His Fangs! Gohan's Transcendent Power Attacks
summary: Vegeta is impressed by Gohan's furious outburst after Frieza strikes a death blow against Krillin. The two Saiyans work together to defeat the monster, but even their combined powers won't be enough spare their lives!

name: The Reborn Piccolo Shows Himself! An Enraged Freeza's Second Transformation
summary: Piccolo joins the battle in progress and quickly attacks Frieza with the strength of two Namekian warriors. The powerful villain is caught off guard, but a second transformation gives him the strength to finish the fight once and for all!

name: Final Super Transformation of Freeza! The Terror Greater than Hell Starts Now
summary: Frieza has begun his ultimate transformation, and Vegeta's only hope to defeat the monster is suffering a mortal wound. If the Saiyan warrior can convince Dende to restore his strength, he may gain the power to defeat his enemy!

name: The Moment We've Waited For! Son Goku is Revived
summary: Vegeta gives his increased power and speed a test run by launching a violent attack on Frieza, but no matter how furiously he fights, the Saiyan is unable to penetrate his enemy's defenses!

name: Defeat Freeza, Son Goku! The Proud Vegeta's Tears
summary: Goku arrives at the battle scene only to find Vegeta battered and badly beaten. With his dying breath, the Saiyan prince reveals the truth about Frieza's roll in the death of Goku's father, prompting a fierce outburst of Saiyan pride!

name: Son Goku vs. Freeza! The Curtain Opens on the Super Decisive Battle!
summary: Goku and Frieza go head to head in a vicious slugfest that threatens to destroy the planet of Namek. Krillin and Gohan are amazed by the brutality of the battle, but Piccolo believes two warriors are just warming up!

name: A Physical War That Exceeds All Limits! Goku and Freeza and Ginyu, Again?!
summary: The bruises are multiplying as Goku and Frieza continue to pummel each other mercilessly! Meanwhile, Bulma's encounter with an unusual frog leads to an out-of-body experience!

name: It's a 20-Fold Kaioken! A Kamehameha With Everything on the Line
summary: After suffering a savage beating at the hands of Frieza, Goku summons the awesome power of the Kaio-Ken! If his desperate attack succeeds, victory will be his, but if it fails, the Saiyan race will be eliminated!

name: This is the Last Trump Card! Goku's Extra-Large Genki-dama
summary: When his most powerful attacks fail to faze Frieza, Goku turns to his ultimate weapon: the Spirit Bomb! Piccolo joins the fight to buy Goku some time, but can the noble Namekian survive long enough to taste sweet victory?

name: Awaken, Legendary Warrior... Son Goku, the Super Saiyan!
summary: With the help of his friends, Goku succeeds in blasting Frieza with a gargantuan Spirit Bomb! Victory seems assured, but when the monster remerges to strike a shockingly fatal blow - Goku undergoes a powerful transformation!

name: The Angry Super Saiyan! Throw Your Hat in the Ring Goku Son!
summary: While Gohan races to save Piccolo, Goku inflicts a Super-Saiyan beating on Frieza. The blonde brawler's impressive new powers drive his opponent to a desperate counterattack that could obliterate Namek!

name: Exact Vengeance Son Goku! The Countdown to the Planet's Collapse
summary: Despite the danger of Namek's impending implosion, Goku continues his battle with Frieza, determined to extract revenge for Krillin's murder. Elsewhere, Gohan tries to locate Bluma before it's too late!

name: Do-or-Die Full Power of Freeza! Shenlong Heed this Wish
summary: Kami and King Kai concoct a plan to restore the wish-granting power of the Namekian Dragon Balls, and Goku continues his epic battle with the villainous Frieza!

name: Furious Battle Cry of Goku! Make it in Time... The Resurrection Wish!
summary: After Goku is seemingly defeated by Frieza, Gohan enters the fight to avenge the loss of his father. Meanwhile, a newly resurrected Dende rushes to make a final wish before planet Namek is destroyed.

name: Two Remain on a Vanishing Planet! This is the Final Showdown
summary: Goku and Frieza continue their epic battle as planet Namek crumbles beneath their feet. Back on Earth, Gohan eagerly awaits word of his father's ultimate fate!

name: The Final Blow, Son Goku... Planet Namek Scatters Throughout Space
summary: Goku's ill-advised display of mercy leads to a treacherous final attack by Frieza. As the epic battle between the two warriors reaches its climax, planet Namek teeters on the brink of ultimate destruction!

name: Goku Vanishes in Space... Return to Life! Super Warriors
summary: Frieza is defeated, Namek has been obliterated, and the whereabouts of Goku remain a mystery. How will Earth carry on without its Super Saiyan hero? And what will become of the Namekian refugees?

name: That's Earth Papa… The Counterattack of Freeza Father and Son
summary: The wreckage of Frieza's body is rebuilt by the monster's fiendish father! Together, they embark on a mission to eradicate life on Earth. Will Goku return home in time to save his friends?

name: I'll Defeat Freeza! Another Super Saiyan
summary: The bone-chilling onslaught of Frieza and King Cold is brought to a halt by a mysterious stranger with a mighty sword, but only time will tell if this new warrior is friend or foe!

name: Welcome Back Son Goku! The Confession of the Mysterious Young Boy Trunks
summary: The formidable stranger finally reveals the secret of his origins after a Super Saiyan sparring session with Goku. The oddly familiar fighter is a visitor from the future sent to deliver a grave warning!

name: Goku's New Technique, Instant Movement! Special Training Staked on 3 Years From Now
summary: Goku tells the amazing story of how he survived the destruction of Namek, and the heroic warriors begin their training for a looming showdown with the Androids!

name: The Pair Who Don't Leave a Trace! The Artificial Humans Appear
summary: Goku and his friends eagerly await the arrival of the Androids, but Yamcha's confrontation with the mechanized monsters suggests that Earth's heroes may be up against more muscle they can handle!

name: Attacked on Both Sides by an Internal Enemy?! Son Goku vs Artificial Human #19
summary: Goku tries to pulverize the Androids with a devastating display of his Super Saiyan strength, but a mysterious ailment prevents the mighty warrior from unleashing his true power!

name: No Chance of Victory Against #19! Super Vegeta Arrives Late
summary: Vegeta's sudden arrival creates an opening for the others to rescue Goku. While Yamcha rushes the fallen hero to safety, Vegeta reveals his new and improved fighting style - including the Big Bang Attack!

name: Piccolo's Assault! The Missing #20 and the Future Gone Eschew
summary: Goku wages a life and death battle with a deadly heart condition, Piccolo takes center stage in the battle to destroy Android 20, and Trunks returns from the future with a disturbing revelation.

name: Pursue! Doctor Gero... The Search for the Mysterious Laboratory!
summary: While Piccolo and company search for Dr. Gero's secret laboratory, Vegeta sets out to hunt down and destroy Android 20. Meanwhile, Trunks tries everything in his power to save his stubborn father!

name: #17 and #18, and...! The Artificial Humans Awaken
summary: The newly activated Androids 17 and 18 provide a display of their unprecedented power and cruelty. Vegeta is eager to fight, but he soon finds himself outnumbered three to one!

name: A Cute Face and Super Power?! #18 vs Vegeta
summary: One by one, Vegeta and his reluctant allies meet horrific ends at the hands of the unstoppable Androids. A bed-stricken Goku is Earth's only hope, but there's a specially-designed Android waiting to destroy him!

name: The Time has Come to Become One Again… Piccolo's Decision for Ultimate Power!
summary: Faced with an unbeatable enemy, Vegeta flies away in a solitary rage, and Piccolo seeks out Kami on a quest to increase his power by whatever means necessary!

name: One More Time Machine?! Bulma Unveils a Mystery
summary: While Kami considers merging with Piccolo, Trunks and the others discover a second time machine. Elsewhere, Vegeta vows to become strong enough to defeat the Android invaders!

name: And So the Monster Makes its Move... Take Off! It's the Super Namekian!
summary: During their investigation of the second time machine, Gohan and company stumble upon the shell of what appears to be a monstrous creature. Later, a horrific vision forces Kami to accept his fate and merge with Piccolo!

name: I am Your Sibling! The Monster with the Aura of Goku
summary: The Super Namekian formerly known as Piccolo finds himself face-to-face with the most terrifying monster the world has ever seen. Who is this new threat? And why does he have Goku's power?

name: Escape tactic,Taiyoken! The Android Cell attacks
summary: Cell - believing he has defeated Piccolo - foolishly reveals the mysteries of his hideous origins. Little does the monster know, the powerful Super Namekian cannot be conquered so easily!

name: Attack the Elusive Cell! Son Goku, Finally Revived!
summary: Cell continues his bloodthirsty rampage, Krillin and Trunks destroy what little remains of Dr. Gero's laboratory, and Goku awakens from his extended slumber ready to fight!

name: Surpass Super Saiyan! Now, Into the Room of Spirit and Time
summary: Goku leads his Saiyan brethren to a secret room designed for highly-advanced training. Meanwhile, Piccolo puts his enhanced powers to the test against an Android adversary!

name: This is the Power of a Super-Namekian! No. 17 vs. Piccolo!
summary: Piccolo and Android 17 trade blows in a battle of unprecedented brutality! Cell - sensing their presence - races to the scene of the skirmish in pursuit of his terrifying perfect form!

name: Run #17! The Suicidal Resistance, Piccolo
summary: Cell's arrival forces Piccolo and the Androids into an uneasy - and temporary - alliance. While the Super Namekian mounts a desperate, final attack, Goku and Gohan wait for Vegeta to emerge from the Room of Spirit and Time!

name: Unmeasured Power! The Silent Warrior #16, Makes his Move
summary: After defeating Piccolo, Cell turns his attention to his true prey: Androids 17 and 18. The monster must absorb them both to achieve his perfect form, but Android 16 still stands in his way!

name: Tenshinhan's Do-or-Die Shin Kikoho! Save Your Brother-in-Arms, Son Goku
summary: Desperate to help Android 18 escape, Tien places his own life at risk in an unwinnable battle with the monster Cell. When the three-eyed warrior's power quickly fades, he'll need a lift from a friend to avoid a gruesome end!

name: Super Saiyan Surpassed! The Daring Vegeta Strikes Cell
summary: Vegeta puts his new powers to the test in a shocking slugfest with Cell. Back in the Room of Spirit and Time, Goku attempts to teach Gohan the secret to a Super Saiyan transformation!

name: The Surging Resentment of Cell! Krillin, Destroy #18
summary: Vegeta is fighting Cell, can he destroy him before he combines with No.18? With the emergency shutdown in hand - can Krillin shut down No.18?

name: And So the Situation Takes a Turn for the Worst... Cell Attacks #18!
summary: As Cell successfully persuades Vegeta to let him reach his Perfect Form, Krillin attempts to get Android 16 and 18 to safety.

name: The Tables Have Turned! Perfect Form Cell, Finally Goes into Action
summary: Krillin and Vegeta fight Perfect Cell, as Trunks prepares to reveal his true power. Meanwhile, Goku and Gohan continue training in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber.

name: Full-Power Strike of Vegeta! But the Terror of Cell Grows and Grows
summary: Vegeta unleashes an awesome attack that leaves Cell shorthanded, but the monster responds with a brutal beat down, knocking the Saiyan prince unconscious and clearing the way for Trunks to enter the fight!

name: Super Power Awakening! Trunks Surpasses his Father
summary: Goku and Gohan continue their Super Saiyan training, and Trunks finds out the hard way that boosting his power to the next level won't stop Cell. The situation looks bleak until the monster throws down a challenge!

name: The Televi Has Been Hijacked! A Live Broadcast of the Cell Games Press Conference
summary: Trunks informs the Z-Fighters of the tournament planned by Cell, and Android 16 is taken to Capsule Corporation to be repaired. Meanwhile, Goku and Gohan continue to train.

name: Training Completed! Does Goku, have the Composure to Defeat Cell?!
summary: Goku and Gohan complete their training in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, and fly down from The Lookout to greet their friends.

name: An Interrupted Rest! The Self-Defense Army, Launches a General Offensive Against Cell
summary: Piccolo and Vegeta train in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, while Goku and Gohan relax at home.

name: A New God! The Dragon Balls are Finally Revived
summary: In an attempt to revive the Dragon Balls, Goku tries to find the new planet where the Namekians are residing with the help of King Kai.

name: Satan's Legion Runs Wild! The Curtain Rises on the Cell Games
summary: The tournament is about to begin, and hulking human with a devilish name is slated to be the first challenger! Can the arrogant champion make good on his boasts, or will Cell teach him the meaning of the word pain?

name: Decisive Battle! Cell vs Son Goku
summary: Goku and Cell prepare to square off in what may be the greatest battle in history! Both fighters are hesitant to reveal their true powers, but once blows are exchanged, the violence quickly escalates!

name: A Battle of the Highest Level! Defeat Cell, Son Goku
summary: Goku and Cell put on an amazing display of ferocious fighting! The monster makes things more interesting by blowing up the ring, and Goku responds with a devastating Kamehameha Wave!

name: Conclusion to the Death Match! Time for Goku's Decision
summary: Goku and Cell battle until both warriors are winded and weary. With the fate of the world hanging in the balance, Goku does the unthinkable. The greatest champion in Earth's history retires!

name: Get Angry Gohan! Release Your Dormant Power
summary: Gohan replaces his father in the battle with Cell, but the boy appears to be no match for his monstrous opponent. His only hope for survival is to unleash the fury lurking deep inside him!

name: The Tears that Disappeared into the Sky! The Angry Super Awakening of Gohan
summary: Android 16 tries to take the bad guy out with a bang, Cell summons his miniature minions, and a cowardly champion risks his life to deliver an important message to Gohan!

name: Fighting Spirit Free from Hesitation! Gohan, Pulverizes the Cell Juniors
summary: Gohan's rage boils over as he races to rescue his friends from the brink of death! Next, the boy gives his new powers a whirl in a bone-crushing battle with the menacing Cell Juniors!

name: The Perfect Form Breaks Down! Explosion, the Super Iron Fist of Rage
summary: Cell reveals the full force of his true power, but Gohan refuses to flinch in the face of danger. As the momentum swings to the Saiyan side, Goku calls for his son to deliver the final blow!

name: Bye-Bye Everyone! This is the Only Way to Save the Earth
summary: Gohan succeeds in defeating Cell, but the monster has one last trick up his sleeve - a devastating development that could destroy the world! For the sake of the future, Goku must prepare himself for the ultimate sacrifice!

name: Combine Our Power! The Mightiest Final Kamehameha
summary: Cell returns with intentions to wipe out planet Earth once and for all! Gohan is badly injured, but with a little help from his friends - and pep talk from his fallen father - he summons a Kamehameha Wave that just might save the world!

name: Farewell with a Smile! Heading for New Days...
summary: In the aftermath of battle, Dende heals the injured heroes and summons the magic Dragon Balls in an attempt to resurrect those killed during Cell's rampage!

name: Bring Peace to the Future! Goku's Spirit is Eternal
summary: Trunks returns to the Future to reunite with his mother. With newfound strength he goes to destroy the Androids once and for all.

name: 7 Years Since That Event! Starting Today, Gohan's a High Schooler
summary: Seven years after the battle with Cell, Gohan is now a high school student attending Orange Star High School.

name: Found Out! The New Hero is Son Gohan
summary: Gohan creates an alias called the "Great Saiyaman", allowing him to stop criminals while also concealing his true identity.

name: Gohan is the Teacher! Videl's Introduction to Flight
summary: Gohan teaches Videl the basics of learning to control her energy.

name: The Dragon Team, All Assembled! Son Goku has Returned!!
summary: On the day of the tournament, Goku is allowed to return to Earth for a 24 hour visit as granted by Fortune Teller Baba.

name: Everyone is Shocked! Goten and Trunks' Super Battle!!
summary: Goku, Vegeta and other others spectate the tournament, while Gohan and Videl wait to take their preliminary test.

name: A Troubling Premonition! The Appearance of a Mysterious Warrior!!
summary: During an intermission, as Goku and the others get something to eat, they are encountered by two mysterious participants.

name: What's the Matter, Piccolo?! An Unexpected Conclusion to the First Round
summary: Piccolo goes up against the mysterious being called Shin.

name: Videl is Worn Ragged, Gohan's Anger at its Limits!!
summary: After Videl is defeated by Spopovitch, Gohan prepares to fight against Kabito.

name: A Slithering Conspiracy!! Secrets of the Terrible Majin
summary: Goku and the others arrive at the site of a buried spaceship and watch as Spopovitch and Yamu deliver Gohan's energy to the evil wizard Babidi and his partner, Dabura.

name: The Heinous Mage Babidi and King of the Underworld Dabra's Trap
summary: Goku, Vegeta, Gohan and Supreme Kai chase after Dabura into the spaceship, where they are confronted by one of Babidi's minions, Pui Pui.

name: Don't Underestimate a Super Saiyan! Vegeta and Goku's Full Throttle Power!
summary: After Vegeta effortlessly defeats Pui Pui, Goku prepares to fight Yakon.

name: Who is the World's Greatest?! A Battle Royal Match to Decide!!
summary: After Goku defeats Yakon, Dabura prepares to fight the Saiyans himself. Meanwhile, a battle royal is held between the remaining contestants of the tournament.

name: The Fearsome Children!! #18's Great Struggle
summary: Android 18 continues fighting the mysterious Mighty Mask.

name: The Star Performer Takes the Stage! Take Down the Demon King!!
summary: Android 18 makes a deal with Hercule to let him win the match in exchange for the prize money. Meanwhile, Gohan fights Dabura.

name: A Wicked Heart is Revived, Vegeta, the Prince of Destruction!
summary: As the battle between Dabura and Gohan continues, Babidi plots to sway Vegeta to his side using magic.

name: I'm the Strongest! The Clash of Goku vs Vegeta
summary: The fight between Goku and Majin Vegeta begins.

name: The Countdown to Revival Crush Babidi's Ambitions!
summary: While the fight between Goku and Majin Vegeta intensifies, Gohan and Supreme Kai attempt to stop Majin Buu from being revived.

name: The Seal is Broken!? Gohan's Kamehameha of Resistance
summary: As the fight between Goku and Majin Vegeta escalates, Gohan attempts to stop Majin Buu from reaching full power.

name: A Straight Line to Despair!? Terror of Majin Buu
summary: As Majin Buu is revived, Gohan and Supreme Kai try to flee from this powerful foe.

name: Turn into Sweets! The Creepy Powers of the Hungry Majin
summary: Majin Buu easily defeats Gohan and Supreme Kai. Fearing that Majin Buu cannot be controlled, Dabura attacks the powerful being.

name: I'll Finish The Majin! Vegeta's Final Fight to the Death
summary: Majin Vegeta fights Majin Buu, and is shocked by Buu's regenerative abilities.

name: For Those Whom He Loves... The Last Moment of the Proud Warrior
summary: A desperate Vegeta sacrifices himself by self-destructing into a massive explosion, in an attempt to destroy Majin Buu once and for all.

name: The Nightmare Returns, The Immortal Monster, Majin Buu
summary: Goku learns of Vegeta's sacrifice, which ultimately failed to defeat Majin Buu. Meanwhile, a weakened Supreme Kai searches for Gohan, whose fate is still unknown.

name: Secret Plan to Defeat Buu, It's Name is Fusion
summary: Understanding that he cannot defeat Majin Buu, Goku teaches Goten and Trunks the fusion technique.

name: A Faint Ray of Hope Has Appeared! Open Your Eyes, Warriors
summary: Kabito and Supreme Kai finally find Gohan, and Babidi makes a worldwide announcement.

name: Find the Nuisance, Babidi's Revenge Plan Begins
summary: Supreme Kai reveals his plan to teach Gohan the art of mastering the legendary Z-Sword in order to defeat Majin Buu. Meanwhile, Goku teaches the fusion technique to Goten and Trunks.

name: Time of Ordeal Attaining the Legendary Power
summary: As Majin Buu lays waste to another city, Goten and Trunks contact Babidi and inform him that they will soon be strong enough to fight Buu. They continue their fusion training.

name: Stop Majin Buu The Limit! Super Saiyan 3
summary: Babidi and Majin Buu plan to destroy West City, however Goku confronts them, hoping to buy some time. Meanwhile, Trunks is on a mission to retrieve the Dragon Radar from West City, which will be destroyed if Buu gets there first.

name: Standing Up For Himself, Buu's Rebellion
summary: Goku, who has transformed into a Super Saiyan 3 for the first time, fights Majin Buu.

name: Awful Looking!? Special Training, Fusion Pose
summary: Due to his energy being drained from transforming into a Super Saiyan 3, Goku does not have much time left on Earth. He wastes no time, teaching Goten and Trunks the final key component to mastering the fusion technique.

name: Bye-Bye, Everyone!! Son Goku Returns to the Afterlife
summary: Goku returns to the afterlife, leaving Piccolo to continue training Goten and Trunks.

name: Found You, Gohan! Harsh Training in the Realm of the Kais!
summary: Goku arrives in the Sacred World of the Kais, where Gohan has been training with the Z-Sword.

name: Birth! Combine Super Warrior, His Name is Gotenks!!
summary: Finally mastering the Fusion Dance, Gotenks goes out on a search for Majin Buu, despite Piccolo's protest. Meanwhile, Old Kai reveals he has the ability to unlock a warrior's true potential.

name: Who Will Be the One to Defeat the Majin? The Beginning of the Strongest Man
summary: Gotenks arrive to fight against Majin Buu.

name: The Power-Up Continues!? Perfected! Super Gotenks
summary: Old Kai begins the process of unlocking Gohan's true potential. Meanwhile, Majin Buu befriends a dog and Gotenks practices becoming a Super Saiyan.

name: That Which is Brought Forth by Anger - Another Majin
summary: After witnessing Hercule getting shot, the evil escapes from Majin Buu's body, releasing a tall, gray and emaciated version of Majin Buu.

name: Buu Ate Buu - Attack of the New Majin
summary: Majin Buu attempts to fight against the Evil Buu, who is revealed to be much more powerful.

name: Head Straight to the Catastrophe! The Deadline is in 1 Hour!!
summary: Piccolo tries to buy some time after Super Buu unleashes a powerful attack which kills most of the lives on Earth.

name: Special Training Completed! You're Finished Now, Majin Buu
summary: Hoping to avenge their loved ones, Gotenks fights Super Buu in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber.

name: Buu Eliminated With Ghosts! A Surefire Kamikaze Attack!!
summary: Gotenks and Super Buu continue to fight, with Gotenks unleashing his special move called the Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack.

name: The Reserved Transformation of Gotenks! Super Gotenks 3!!"
summary: Super Buu manages to escape the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, causing Gotenks to finally unleashes his trump card.

name: In High Spirits! Buu-Buu Volleyball!
summary: Gotenks and Super Buu continue their battle.

name: You Kept Everyone Waiting! A Reborn Gohan Returns to Earth!!
summary: As victory seems near for Super Buu, who overpowers a weakened Gotenks, Gohan arrives just in time.

name: Buu is Overwhelmed! Ultimate Gohan's Super Power
summary: With newfound powers unlocked by Old Kai, Gohan fights Super Buu.

name: Buu's Trick - Gotenks is Absorbed?!
summary: Super Buu devises a plan to gain the upper hand against Gohan.

name: The Great Kaiōshin's Bright Idea! Son Goku is Revived!!
summary: Super Buu's plan of absorbing Piccolo and Gotenks succeeds, and begins to outmatch Gohan.

name: One Time Only Miracle… Will the Super Combination With That Guy Come About?
summary: Desperate to match Super Buu's power, Goku convinces Vegeta to fuse with him using the Potara earrings.

name: Invincible! Ultimate Warrior Vegetto!
summary: The ultimate fusion of Goku and Vegeta, Vegito fights Super Buu.

name: The Ace Up Buu's Sleeve! The Warriors are Absorbed!!
summary: Vegito continues to fight Super Buu, who is clearly outmatched by the Saiyan warrior.

name: Rescuing Gohan and Company! Goku and Vegeta's Infiltration Mission!
summary: Super Buu absorbs Vegito, who had planned for the turn of events in order to save his friends and family.

name: Emergency Escape from Inside the Body! Buu's Reverse-Transformation is the Worst!!
summary: Still absorbed inside his body, Goku and Vegeta fight the beings manifesting from Buu's mind.

name: Earth Disappears!! The Original Buu's Single Cruel Blast!!
summary: Vegeta and Goku save their friends and family, causing Super Buu to regress into his original, child-like form.

name: Final Decisive Battle! A Conclusion in the Realm of the Kais!!
summary: Goku fights Kid Buu on the Sacred World of the Kais.

name: Do Your Best, Kakarrot! You Are No. 1!!
summary: Goku powers up to Super Saiyan 3 in an attempt to destroy Buu once and for all.

name: A One Minute Battle Vegeta's Life Risking Stall Tactics!
summary: Vegeta steps in to fight Kid Buu, while an exhausted Goku attempts to regather his power.

name: A Secret Plan Comes Together in a Flash - Please Grant These Two Wishes
summary: Fat Majin Buu enters the fight and saves Vegeta from death. Meanwhile, Dende makes two wishes using the Namekian Dragon Balls.

name: Give Me Energy! We'll Make a Huge Genki-Dama!!
summary: The people of Earth are wished back to life, and Goku begins creating the Spirit Bomb in a final attempt to destroy Buu.

name: The Savior of the World is You! Everyone's Spirit Bomb is Completed
summary: Vegeta attempts to convince the people of Earth to give their energy for the Spirit Bomb. Meanwhile, Fat Majin Buu has lost all his energy, and Kid Buu begins another onslaught onto Vegeta, forcing him to fight again.

name: Son Goku is the Strongest After All!! Majin Buu is Annihilated
summary: Goku struggles to destroy Kid Buu, who pushes back against the Spirit Bomb.

name: And So, After 10 Years... The First Tenka'ichi Budōkai in a Long Time!
summary: It has been ten years since Buu was defeated. Goku, Goten, Vegeta and Trunks enter the World Martial Arts Tournament, where they also meet up with old friends and family.

name: Even Stronger! Goku's Dream Never Ends!!
summary: The World Martial Arts Tournament begins, and Goku battles the mysterious fighter called Uub.
